name: CKEditor Description List
description: Provides a CKEditor 5 plugin to create description lists.
project_description: CKEditor Description List adds a CKEditor 5 plugin that lets editors build HTML description lists (<dl> with <dt> term and <dd> description pairs) from a WYSIWYG toolbar button. Version 3.x is a native CKEditor 5 plugin (the module dropped the old CKEditor 4 library dependency): a single toolbar item 'toggleDescriptionList' (label 'Description list') inserts a <dl> widget; if text is selected, each line is converted to a <dt>/<dd> pair, splitting on the first colon so 'Term: definition' becomes a term and its description. The plugin is declared in ckeditor_descriptionlist.ckeditor5.yml (id ckeditor_descriptionlist_descriptionlist) and its allowed-HTML 'elements' list is exactly <dl>, <dd>, <dt>, so adding the button to a text format also permits those three semantic tags through that format's Limit allowed HTML tags filter. It is PHP-free apart from a trivial CKEditor5PluginDefault subclass; there is no settings form, no config object, no permission, and no service. Depends on Drupal core's ckeditor5 module; core requirement ^10.5 || ^11. Install as a normal contributed module, then add the Description list button to a CKEditor 5 text format's active toolbar.
